\n-- ===================================.business_requirement: The business requires automated, real-time synchronization between physical store POS systems and the digital platform to prevent overselling and revenue leakage.
\n-- ===================================.business_objective: Ensure accurate inventory availability to maintain high customer satisfaction and prevent financial loss from uncollectible orders.
\n-- ===================================.business_value: Prevents failed deliveries and revenue leakage while ensuring regulatory compliance and operational efficiency.
\n-- ===================================.success_measures: ["Zero overselling incidents per 1,000 orders (proposed)", "Inventory data latency under 5 seconds", "Reduction in order cancellation rate due to stock errors by 90%"]

\n-- ===================================.business_requirement: The business requires an automated system to dynamically assign orders to gig workers and calculate optimal delivery paths to ensure efficient fulfillment and cost control.
\n-- ===================================.business_objective: Maintain profitability in a low-margin model while meeting strict time commitments required to satisfy the quick commerce promise.
\n-- ===================================.business_value: Meeting delivery targets ensures customer satisfaction and repeat usage, while dynamic routing minimizes operational costs and prevents order failures.
\n-- ===================================.success_measures: ["Proposed: Average delivery time reduction of 15% within 3 months", "Proposed: Reduction in failed delivery attempts by 20%", "Proposed: Increase in gig worker utilization rate to 85%"]

\n-- ===================================.functional_requirement_name: The system shall continuously recalculate optimal delivery paths for Delivery Partners by integrating live traffic data and new Order Request insertions.

\n-- ===================================.business_requirement: The business requires predictive analytics reports on demand patterns and inventory turnover to optimize resource allocation and reduce overselling incidents.

\n-- ===================================.epic_title: This serves the goal of maintaining ultra-fast delivery promises and preventing revenue loss during third-party outages.
\n-- ===================================.business_requirement_name: Automated fallback routing and vendor diversification
\n-- ===================================.business_requirement: The business requires resilient order allocation capabilities that automatically switch to alternative logistics providers or mapping services when primary external dependencies fail.
\n-- ===================================.business_objective: This serves the goal of maintaining ultra-fast delivery promises and preventing revenue loss during third-party outages.
\n-- ===================================.business_value: If met, the business ensures continuous operations and customer trust; if not, service interruptions will lead to order cancellations and regulatory non-compliance.
\n-- ===================================.success_measures: ["Zero critical order delays during external provider outages", "Automated failover activation within proposed 5 minutes of outage detection", "Maintained order fulfillment rate of proposed 99.5% during dependency failures"]
\n-- ===================================.policies_and_constraints: ["Failover logic must prioritize customer delivery timeframes over cost optimization.", "Switching between providers must not require manual intervention by the Platform Operator.", "System must log all fallback events for post-incident analysis by the Regulatory Authority."]

\n-- ===================================.risks_and_dependencies: ["Dependency on the availability of secondary vendors which may also experience outages.", "Latency in detecting the primary provider failure could delay the switch.", "Incompatibility of data formats between the Order Allocation Engine and alternative providers."]

\n-- ===================================.business_requirement: The business requires the Platform Operator to automatically send timely updates via SMS, email, or app push when an order status changes to Ready for Delivery or Assigned to a Delivery Partner.
\n-- ===================================.business_objective: This serves the goal of reducing support inquiries and improving the overall customer delivery experience through transparency.
\n-- ===================================.business_value: Meeting this requirement reduces customer frustration and support costs, while failure leads to increased complaints and lower retention.
\n-- ===================================.success_measures: ["Customer support ticket volume related to order status reduced by proposed 20%", "Customer satisfaction score for delivery communication reaches proposed 4.5/5", "Notification delivery success rate exceeds proposed 98%"]
\n-- ===================================.policies_and_constraints: ["Notifications must comply with local telecommunications and data privacy regulations.", "Messages must be sent within 2 minutes of the status change event.", "Customers must be able to opt-out of non-critical promotional notifications."]
\n-- ===================================.assumptions: ["The Order Allocation Engine provides accurate, real-time status updates to the notification system.", "Customers have provided valid contact preferences during onboarding.", "Third-party SMS and email providers maintain high uptime availability."]
\n-- ===================================.risks_and_dependencies: ["Dependency on external messaging providers may cause delays during network outages.", "Incorrect status data from the Order Allocation Engine could trigger false notifications.", "High message volume during peak hours may exceed carrier rate limits."]
\n-- ===================================.functional_requirement_name: The system shall orchestrate multi-channel notifications (SMS, email, app push) by automatically triggering messages when an Order Request status changes to Ready for Delivery or Assigned to a Delivery Partner.
\n-- ===================================.functional_requirement_description: The system shall detect a status change on an Order Request from 'Packed' to 'Ready for Delivery' and trigger a notification., The system shall detect a status change on an Order Request from 'Ready for Delivery' to 'Assigned' and trigger a notification., The system shall retrieve the Customer Profile to determine the primary contact method and preferred notification channel., The system shall send the notification via the selected channel using the contact details found in the Customer Profile., The system shall log the notification attempt and the delivery status of the message in a Feedback Record., The system shall suppress duplicate notifications if a message for the same event has already been sent within a defined cooldown period.
\n-- ===================================.requirement: "The system shall orchestrate multi-channel notifications (SMS, email, app push) by automatically triggering messages when an Order Request status changes to Ready for Delivery or Assigned to a Delivery Partner."
\n-- ===================================.business_need: "The business needs to ensure customers receive timely, consistent updates across all preferred channels to reduce support inquiries and improve the delivery experience."

\n-- ===================================.epic_title: This serves the goal of revenue optimization and Service Level Agreement (SLA) adherence during supply-demand fluctuations.
\n-- ===================================.business_requirement_name: Dynamic Pricing Engine for Demand-Based Fees
\n-- ===================================.business_requirement: The business requires a dynamic pricing mechanism that adjusts delivery fees and commissions in real-time based on demand, weather, and traffic conditions.
\n-- ===================================.business_objective: This serves the goal of revenue optimization and Service Level Agreement (SLA) adherence during supply-demand fluctuations.
\n-- ===================================.business_value: Meeting this requirement maximizes revenue during peak times and ensures timely deliveries; failure results in lost revenue and breached delivery promises.
\n-- ===================================.success_measures: ["Achieve a proposed 15% increase in revenue during peak demand periods", "Maintain a proposed 98% on-time delivery rate during high-congestion events", "Reduce customer order abandonment rate by proposed 10% due to excessive fees"]

\n-- ===================================.functional_requirement_name: The system shall enable the Platform Operator to create, modify, and version geospatial service area definitions and travel time matrices to ensure accurate delivery feasibility and pricing.

\n-- ===================================.epic_title: This serves the goal of simplifying the shopping experience and enabling monetization through transaction commissions and advertising on a consolidated marketplace.
\n-- ===================================.business_requirement_name: Unified Digital Marketplace Interface
\n-- ===================================.business_requirement: The business requires a unified digital interface that aggregates fragmented inventory from multiple store partners to present a comprehensive assortment to customers.
\n-- ===================================.business_objective: This serves the goal of simplifying the shopping experience and enabling monetization through transaction commissions and advertising on a consolidated marketplace.
\n-- ===================================.business_value: Meeting this requirement increases customer retention and revenue; failure results in a fragmented user experience and lost sales opportunities.
\n-- ===================================.success_measures: ["proposed 95% of customers find all required items in a single search", "proposed 20% increase in average order value due to cross-store availability", "proposed reduction in customer support queries regarding stock availability by 30%"]
\n-- ===================================.policies_and_constraints: ["Inventory data must be synchronized in real-time to prevent overselling.", "The interface must comply with data privacy regulations regarding customer location and purchase history.", "Store partners must retain the right to define their own product categorization within the unified catalog."]
\n-- ===================================.assumptions: ["Store partners will provide accurate and up-to-date inventory feeds via API.", "Customers expect a seamless browsing experience without distinguishing between different store sources.", "Network latency will not exceed thresholds that delay inventory updates during peak hours."]
\n-- ===================================.risks_and_dependencies: ["Dependency on the Order Allocation Engine to validate inventory availability before display.", "Risk of data inconsistency if store partners fail to update stock levels promptly.", "Potential complexity in managing conflicting pricing or promotional offers across different store partners."]
\n-- ===================================.functional_requirement_name: The system shall enable customers to create, validate, and submit order requests containing selected items, quantities, and delivery instructions.
